name: George Wallace House
address: 605 West Truman Road, Independence, Jackson County, MO

location.how: centre of the building's outline clicked by hand on the public ortho mo-2023-2024 (2024, 0.150 m/px), pixel (265, 652)

standing.note: L-shaped roof next door west of 601 (Frank Wallace), about 44 x 55 ft at the roof edge on the ortho against walls of 40 x 47 ft plus overhangs and the front porch; no addition visible. NPS-owned (Harry S Truman NHS).

roof.note: Front-gable main roof: eaves on the sheet's top and bottom sides, gable over the open front porch on the left. Hipped wing: eaves on its top, right and bottom sides; flat roof with railing over the bath bump-out. Roof plan strings: top 44'-11" + 8'-4 1/4" = 53'-3 1/4" to the wing's right eave, bottom 29'-7 1/4" + 23'-9 1/4" = 53'-4 1/2" to the same eave (1 1/4" apart), then 4'-9 1/4" to the flat roof's edge; right side 11'-6" + 11'-3" + 10'-9 3/4" + 9'-4 3/4". Outline not transcribed as a chain.
roof.derive_note: front gable over the porch, hipped rear wing and a flat roof over the side bath: no single pitch

flags.note: No printed east-west overall for the walls: 54'-9 3/4" (top) and 54'-9 1/4" (bottom) include the 7'-9 1/2" open porch (walls alone 47'-0 1/4" top, 46'-11 3/4" bottom). North-south the left overall 39'-11 1/2" runs bay top to the lower wing's bottom wall; the chain's extent is 40.02 ft on the right-hand strings.

Top and bottom strings disagree on where the bedroom wing's right wall is: top 30'-3 1/2" from the bay puts it 40'-7 3/4" from the front wall, bottom 22'-2 1/4" + 18'-8 1/4" puts it 40'-10 1/2" (2 3/4" more); each overall still agrees within 1/2" because the bath bump-out differs the other way (top 6'-4 1/2", bottom 6'-1 1/4"). On the drawing the bump-out scales about 6.2 ft. The chain takes each wall from the string facing it, so the two discrepancies cancel to the overalls' 1/2" and the chain closes.
Right overall 38'-3 1/2" vs its four segments 7'-11 3/4" + 8'-8 1/4" + 9'-7 3/4" + 11'-9 3/4" = 38'-1 1/2"; the sheet scales 38.13 ft (3813 px), with the segments. The chain uses the segments.

Left side: the five segments between the main block's bottom wall and its top wall add to 22'-4 1/2" but the overall less the other segments leaves 22'-2 1/2", and the sheet scales 22.18 ft; the 4'-3 1/2" segment scales 4.15 ft and is probably the misprint. The chain uses 22'-2 1/2".
Grade is printed per elevation side, 1'-5 3/4" to 3'-10" below the first floor; the east elevation's 2'-0 1/2" is used. Eave above grade ranges 9.2 to 11.6 ft by side.
